text: Mira presses a fresh clearance-color sticker onto a supply crate while Bill quietly reads it twice and adjusts his glasses
Osmund rehearses a formal handshake with an empty coat rack in the depot bay while Mira watches from the doorway with folded arms
Tim drifts slowly along the shelves in his glass dome, blue light pulsing, while Bill counts ration tins without looking up
Bill folds a grey cloak into a perfect square on the workbench while Osmund tries to copy him with a second cloak and ends up with a lumpy pile
Mira raises heavy field binoculars at the fogged window, lowers them, and gives Osmund one slow nod while he waits for news
Osmund carefully stacks ration tins into a tall wobbling column on the counter while Tim hovers close to inspect it
